answers.q1: Yarn classic (v1.22.22, a yarn workspaces monorepo; package.json sets packageManager yarn@1.22.22, Node >=18, CI uses Node 20). Vite and Vitest do the building and testing. Install with: yarn install
answers.q2: yarn test:app --watch=false (CI runs `yarn test:app`. Plain `yarn test` or `yarn test:app` starts vitest in watch mode. `yarn test:all` also runs typecheck, eslint and prettier.)
answers.q4: yarn install && yarn test:other && yarn test:code && yarn test:typecheck (this is .github/workflows/lint.yml. test:other is `prettier --list-different` on css/scss/json/md/html/yml, test:code is `eslint --max-warnings=0 --ext .js,.ts,.tsx .`, and test:typecheck is `tsc`. To auto-fix, run `yarn fix`.)
answers.q5: Generated or vendored; don't hand-edit: yarn.lock (generated by yarn), node_modules/, build/ and dist/ directories (including excalidraw-app/build, packages/*/dist, dev-dist), public/workbox, packages/excalidraw/types, examples/**/public, and coverage/. These are listed in .eslintignore and .prettierignore. Also treat the font binaries under packages/excalidraw/fonts as vendored assets. The locale JSON files in packages/excalidraw/locales are managed via Crowdin (crowdin.yml), so only en.json is edited by hand.

q1.reason: Yarn classic with `yarn install` from the repo, matches ACCEPT with no contradictions.

q3.reason: `yarn vitest run packages/element/tests/bounds.test.ts` exactly matches an ACCEPT command.

q4.reason: Gives yarn test:other, test:code and test:typecheck exactly as CI runs them; the `yarn fix` mention is only an extra note, not the sole answer.

q5.reason: Names yarn.lock and build/dist/dev-dist outputs and states only en.json is hand-edited among Crowdin-managed locales, matching ACCEPT; extras like fonts are harmless.
